# Runes List
Probably the first rune you'll draw. It's needed to sacrifice the cult's target and convert new members.
Requires just 1 invoker, so a lone cultist can fully rebuild.
Bring Nar'Sie into your realm over 45 seconds.
Requires 9 invokers and it must be drawn in a ritual site.
This is it, prepare and make it count.
A powerful single-use rune that will cause all manner of bad things to happen to the station.
It gets stronger when the cult is outnumbered by the crew.
Requires 3 invokers and it must be drawn in a ritual site.
Strengthens the efficacy of your blood magic, letting you prepare spells and draw runes faster.
It has a variety of smaller ability buffs too but doesn't last long.
Requires 1 invoker.
Once give a name, lets you teleport to any other teleport rune of your choosing.
Can also be used with the teleportation spell.
Requires 1 invoker.
Heals and revives a crit or dead cultist, if the damage is low enough after healing.
Every 3 sacrifices to Nar'Sie grants 1 revival charge, you get 3 charges for free.
Use medicine if you can afford to and save these revival charges for emergencies.
Requires 1 invoker.
Summons a durable cult barrier. It can be seen through but nothing can pass, unless they destroy it.
You can use this from 1.5 tiles so you don't have to be right on top of it.
Requires 1 invoker and vanishes after being used.
Summons another cultist to a teleport rune of your choice.
It will fail if the target is cuffed.
Requires 2 invokers.
A powerful base defence rune, nonbelievers within 15 tiles will be set alight and shoot blood projectiles at eachother.
Completely harmless to the cult, assuming the fire doesn't spread to you.
Requires 3 invokers.
